title: Cortee – Maintain your documentation in under a second
excerpt: Cortee keeps your documentation current. Tell it what changed and it updates the live page in about 0.7 seconds.
content_html:
Write documentation fast
with minimal effort.

When you tell Cortee what changed, it updates the live page in under a second1.

Write what you know. Cortee applies the edit. You remain in control.

  1. Write what you know

    Think of it as your notepad. Use a few words to describe what changed.

  2. Cortee applies the edit

    The edit lands on the live page, so you can see what changed right away.

  3. You remain in control

    Every paragraph is backed by the facts you wrote, so you can see where any line came from.

Why Cortee

< 1 second

.

Most edits land in under a second.

A wiki leaves the writing to people, so trust stays high and updates stay slow. A markdown repository can rewrite entire pages, then leave changes that are hard to follow. Cortee takes a narrower path. From the fact you provide, it proposes a small change tied to that fact, and you decide what remains on the page.

AI documentation that stays current · Docs without Git · Compare

Related pages

  • Fact-based live-page edits
  • Keep the source on the paragraph
  • Documentation that stays current
  • Review before you keep
  • One live page for shared documents
  • Shared pages without the mess

For more information, visit our Privacy Policy and Data Processing Agreement.

What we never do

  • We do not train on your data.
  • We do not sell your data.

Where it lives

  • Documents are stored in the EU on AWS in Ireland, including history and logs.
  • Sign-in, search, and generation currently run in the United States.

Access and control

  • Access is separate for each organization.
  • Access is restricted and logged.
  • You can export or delete your data on request.
